mapper.sql: left join basket_partner_support_record r on r.partner_id = p.id and r.is_delete = 0 and r.publish_status = 1 and r.support_type = 'CASH' and r.support_amount is not null
mapper.select: select count(1) from basket_partner p where

select ifnull(sum(r.support_amount), 0) from basket_partner_support_record r inner join basket_partner p on p.id = r.partner_id where r.is_delete = 0 and r.publish_status = 1 and r.support_type = 'CASH' and r.support_amount is not null and p.is_delete = 0 and p.partner_status = 1

select p.id as recordId, p.id as partnerId, p.partner_name as partnerName, lf.access_url as partnerLogoUrl, p.website_url as websiteUrl, 'CASH' as supportType, ifnull(sum(r.support_amount), 0) as supportAmount, date_format(max(r.support_date), '%Y-%m-%d') as supportDate, null as publicDescription from basket_partner p left join basket_file_asset lf on lf.id = p.logo_file_id and lf.is_delete = 0
where group by p.id, p.partner_name, lf.access_url, p.website_url, p.sort_no order by supportAmount desc, p.sort_no desc, p.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
